name: canva-marketing
description: Use the official Canva MCP server to create, export, resize, and organize marketing designs directly from any AI agent — no browser required.

capabilities.name: Generate Design from Prompt
capabilities.description: Create any marketing design from a natural language description

capabilities.name: Search Design Library
capabilities.description: Find existing Canva designs by keyword or type

capabilities.name: Export Design
capabilities.description: Export designs as PDF, PNG, JPG, GIF, PPTX, or MP4

capabilities.name: Resize Across Formats
capabilities.description: Adapt one design to any platform dimension (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)

capabilities.name: Import External File
capabilities.description: Turn a PDF, PowerPoint, or Google Doc into an editable Canva design

capabilities.name: Organize Campaign Assets
capabilities.description: Create folders and organize all designs for a campaign

capabilities.name: Design Review Comments
capabilities.description: Add comments to designs for async review workflows

workflows.name: Social Media Post
workflows.trigger: social post, instagram, linkedin, twitter, facebook graphic

workflows.name: Multi-Platform Campaign Pack
workflows.trigger: all sizes, all formats, resize for platforms, campaign assets

workflows.name: Brand Asset Creation
workflows.trigger: logo, brand kit, business card, letterhead, brand guidelines

workflows.name: Campaign Organization
workflows.trigger: organize, campaign folder, keep assets together
